headline: Mistral previews durable Managed Agents with restart recovery and approval waits
summary: Mistral introduced Managed Agents and its Python Agents SDK in public preview on 5 November. The documented service stores sessions for deployed agents, supports background execution and approval waits, and says a worker crash resumes from its last completed model or tool call. Teams can run the same agent in-process, self-host the harness or deploy a Mistral-managed worker. The documentation lists defaults of 24 hours per session, four idle hours and one hour for an approval wait, with higher limits configurable. These are provider-described capabilities; no independent service test or production outcome was verified.
